messages:
Maria L.: FYI the GH Actions nightly for the "quantization-eval" workflow didn't run last night at 02:00 UTC. I noticed missing artifacts in S3. :thinking_face:
Kai T.: saw that too. runner logs show GitHub returned 202 on our workflow_dispatch backfill call. weird. did something change with the gha runner?
Anand: I think this is the `actions/runner` autoscale bug — ephemeral runners sometimes fail to register if the token is reused quickly. We saw a similar pattern on buildkite last month.
Olivia: can we confirm whether it's the runner or the cron trigger? If cron fired but no runner, GH shows `workflow_run` queued but never started.
Maria L.: I pulled the GitHub audit events — cron triggered at 02:00 (payload id 9421) but the runner init events are missing. so cron + dispatch worked; runner failed to pick up.
Kai T.: ok — short-term: propose a backfill job that iterates missed dates and calls `workflow_dispatch` with `ref` + `inputs` and posts to our backfill queue (buildkite or github API). That'll re-run evals and repopulate artifacts.
Anand: agree. also add a guard for concurrency in the GHA workflow to avoid spamming ephemeral runners: `concurrency: 
  group: quant-eval-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false`
Maria L.: good call. can you sketch the small GHA snippet we would add to the backfill helper?
Kai T.: sure — sample:```yaml
name: backfill-quant-evals
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  backfill:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: call-eval-workflow
        run: |
          for d in "$@"; do
            gh api -X POST /repos/redwood-inference/platform/actions/workflows/quant-eval.yml/dispatches -f ref=main -F inputs.date="$d"
          done
```
Anand: note that `gh api` needs a PAT with `workflow` scope. we'll use the service principal in our secrets manager.
Olivia: long-term fix: make runners more resilient and add retry semantics in the cron orchestration. we can also move expensive evals to dedicated buildkite queue that has reserved capacity.
Maria L.: for CI gating: we still want PR-level quick smoke evals to run on GHA matrix, but heavy nightly/long regressions should be batched to Buildkite. if nightly fails because of runner flakiness we should not let PR gating be blocked.
Kai T.: propose change: PR workflow uses `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` with a small matrix (dataset subset) and posts full-eval job to a `needs: [post-to-backfill]` that creates a Buildkite job. That way PR status is immediate and detailed results land in the dashboard asynchronously.
Anand: also add a regression flag when writing eval artifacts: `metadata: {run_type: "nightly" | "pr" , quant_profile: "q4_0"}` — easier for dashboards to filter.
Maria L.: Dashboard integration: I saw the Console ingestion expects artifacts at `s3://redwood-evals/{model}/{date}.tar.gz` and a manifest `manifest.json`. Backfill must re-upload artifacts and update manifest with `ci_run_id` + `metrics_url`.
Olivia: ops — retention concerns: nightly produces ~3GB/day currently. We should compress artifacts and expire PR artifacts after 7 days. Add lifecycle on S3.
Kai T.: Regarding flakiness detection, add a small step in the workflow: if run time > 6h or job stage stuck, auto-abort and escalate to #eng-oncall with `@olivia`.
Maria L.: also need clearer failure modes in the reporter: distinguish `infrastructure_failure` vs `metric_regression`. Right now dashboard lumps both as `failed`.
Anand: for the CI wiring: I'll add a GH Actions workflow that stamps artifacts and pushes a minimal `status.json` to our reporting service. Example `status.json`:```json
{
  "model":"mistral-7b-q4_0",
  "date":"2026-02-01",
  "run_type":"nightly",
  "status":"complete",
  "metrics_url":"https://console.redwood.ai/evals/12345"
}
```
Kai T.: good. one more: set `workflow_dispatch` inputs to accept `backfill_start` & `backfill_end` and verify idempotency (if artifact exists skip).
Maria L.: timeline — can we have the backfill helper + GHA concurrency guard + S3 lifecycle in the next sprint?
Anand: yes. I'll open a PR with the helper script and the workflow change today.
Kai T.: I'll update the PR gating docs in `docs/ci/evals.md` to reflect the split PR vs nightly policy.
Olivia: I'll add an alert in ops for missed cron runs: Datadog synthetic that queries last manifest timestamp and fires if > 36h.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: Created issue #452: "gha: backfill helper + concurrency guard for quant-evals" and linked PR 867.
Maria L.: sweet. after backfill completes, we'll diff metrics (A/B) and ensure no quantization regressions slipped in. please tag `@anand` in the diff review. :thumbsup:
Kai T.: thanks all. I'll watch the backfill queue tomorrow morning and report in this thread.
